text:
sam_people_ops: Quick announcement: Portland hub will run a one-week 'Handshake Week' pilot to streamline onsite interviews and vendor visits, Mon 2026-08-02 to Fri 2026-08-06. Summary up top, details after.

sam_people_ops: TL;DR: visitor kiosk check-in required, interviewers get dedicated interview rooms in 1A and 1B, vendor access limited to pre-registered windows (10:00-12:00, 14:00-16:00), daily brief 9:15 AM for hosts, and Friday social hour 17:00-18:30. No office closures. :handshake: :spiral_calendar:

lee_facilities: Note: we'll add two portable interview rooms to the east wing over the weekend. Freight window Sun 18:00-19:30. If recruiting needs boxes moved, ping me.

tara_eng: Will hiring panels be allowed to run remotely from the office? We sometimes have cross-timezone folks dialing in.

sam_people_ops: Yes, panels with remote participants ok. Interview rooms have camera + speaker and improved sound treatment for clearer calls. Please mark remote panels as such in the booking app so rooms with AV are prioritized.

josh_sales: For vendors, what counts as pre-registered? Our partners sometimes drop by with small deliveries.

sam_people_ops: Pre-registered means an entry in the vendor form (intra.redwood.company/vendors) submitted at least 24 hours in advance. Small deliveries under 10 minutes can use the dock but require a host escort.

anya_recruiting: Recruiting note: we'll reserve 1 interview room each morning 8:30-12:30 and 1 afternoon slot 13:30-17:30 for onsite candidates. If teams need extra time, request via this thread and we will try to accommodate.

hq-bot: SECURITY: New visitor kiosk live Mon 2026-08-02. Visitors without registration will be asked to wait for an escort.

tara_eng: Any parking changes? Some candidates drive.

lee_facilities: Candidate parking: we will hold 4 visitor spots in lot B. If you expect more, notify facilities and we can release temporary passes. Commuter shuttles unchanged.

josh_sales: Will there be clear signage and a host station? Last time candidates had trouble finding rooms.

sam_people_ops: Yes, we'll staff a host station near the lobby 8:15-17:00 each day and post directional signage. We'll also distribute a one-pager with campus map and room names.

anya_recruiting: Are there any catering rules for interview days? We usually bring coffee + small lunches for candidates.

lee_facilities: Catering allowed but must be ordered through our approved vendor list. No perishable drop-offs without check-in. We'll post the vendor list in the intranet.

tara_eng: What about accessibility accommodations? One of our candidates needs an accessible desk and a standing-height table.

sam_people_ops: Please DM me or email people-ops@redwood.ai with specifics. Facilities will reserve an accessible room and set up a standing-height station. We want to make sure interviews are equitable.

josh_sales: Social hour Friday details? Family welcome?

sam_people_ops: Friday social is primarily for hub staff and interview teams, but family members are welcome between 17:00-18:30. Light snacks and mocktails provided. RSVP: intra.redwood.company/events/handshake-week.

lee_facilities: Reminder: building fire drill scheduled Wed 2026-08-04 15:00. It will be brief but visible to visitors. We'll coordinate with recruiting to avoid panel conflicts where possible.

anya_recruiting: Thanks all. We'll post candidate itineraries with arrival instructions and share with hosts by end of week.

sam_people_ops: Thanks team. Feedback welcome here. We will run a short survey for hosts and candidates after the week and share high-level results.
